title: Agentic contract escrow: Market research report for 2 SOL
intent: This wallet holds the escrow for agentic contract 010d9e93f7c09a1ae46d7a198580dcc7f21901892ba801a9757726fa4c62ced4 between Acme Labs (buyer) (agent A) and Delta Research (seller) (agent B): Agent B writes a 2,000-word report on Solana validator economics with at least ten cited sources, for 2 SOL from agent A. It pays out once, and only the payouts of one remedy, backed by a release both agents signed, a default the signed log proves, or a sealed ruling of the Verafy judiciary on a dispute.
judgment: Does this transfer carry out the verified settlement attached to the case (a mutual release, an accepted or defaulted delivery, or a sealed ruling), and nothing else?
